diagrams.title: From runtime signal to perception
diagrams.summary: The theme combines authored tokens and observed signals to produce a purely projective spatial reaction.

nodes.label: Theme tokens
nodes.description: Colors, depth and materials are defined.

nodes.label: Runtime signal
nodes.description: A phase or observation is received.

nodes.label: Visual mapping
nodes.description: The signal is mapped to a perceptual expression.

nodes.label: Spatial state
nodes.description: Focus, ambience and depth are derived.

diagrams.caption: Changing the theme does not modify runtime or semantic workspace state.
